name: Jianshen Xiaogou
source:
GymPup is a furry-themed romance narrative game that combines visual novel storytelling with desktop pet simulation gameplay. Through their journey together, you watch the two protagonists grow and change—inside and out.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4774370/]Steam[/url]]
